newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares close lower in continuous trade.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares close lower in continuous trade.

text.p: Budimex, Stalexport and Universal closed lower and BRE and BIG closed higher in Warsaw bourse continuous trade on Friday.
The other six stocks were flat or did not trade.
Turnover was at 1.8 million zlotys, down from Thursday's 5.7 million zlotys.
NFI units rose 3.2 percent a 10.9-million-zloty turnover. On Thursday NFI turnover was at 17.9 million zlotys.
